content: One of the aims of this study was to see if using semi-supervised learning is beneficial for emotion intensity tasks. For this purpose, the DISC BIBREF0 corpus was used. This corpus was created by querying certain emotion-related words, which makes it very suitable as a semi-supervised corpus. However, the specific emotion the tweet belonged to was not made public. Therefore, a method was applied to automatically assign the tweets to an emotion by comparing our scraped tweets to this new data set.
